title: Astral Heron's triggered effect 'your next card costs [2][rainbow][rainbow] less' is unimplemented (resolves as a raw-text no-op).
expected: Card def ven.json:1577-1579 has rulesText but abilities:[]/parseSuccess:false; the runtime parser matches the trigger via trigger-patterns.ts:373-379 ("When you play your first card each turn") but no effect parser handles "your next card costs [2][rainbow][rainbow] less" (only "I cost X less" static/self cost-reduction exists: effect-keyword-parser.ts:357-363, static-parser.ts), so the effect falls back to {type:"raw"}. Engine executeEffect (riftbound-engine/src/abilities/effect-executor.ts:150-156) has no EFFECT_HANDLERS["raw"] entry and silently no-ops. Existing ruling test astral-heron-8cedb5e8fc134531.test.ts encodes this exact bug as test.failing ("engine applies no discount") and it currently passes (i.e., the discount is indeed not applied) when run with bun test.
observed: Trigger fired and went on the chain with effect {"type":"raw","text":"your next card costs :rb_energy_2::rb_rune_rainbow::rb_rune_rainbow: less."}; after resolving it, hand still showed Shipyard Skulker cost 3 and playing it deducted full cost: energy 8 -> 5. No cost reduction applied.

history.note: already fixed at HEAD: astral-heron ruling test green (next-card discount applies)

resolution.note: already fixed at HEAD: astral-heron ruling test green (next-card discount applies)
